hook: NVIDIA is acquiring Hugging Face for nearly thirteen billion dollars.
spoken_script: NVIDIA is acquiring Hugging Face for nearly thirteen billion dollars. In a massive open-source AI consolidation, NVIDIA agreed to buy Hugging Face for twelve point nine billion dollars. Hugging Face currently hosts over one point five million open models and three hundred thousand datasets. NVIDIA committed to preserving compute neutrality, pledging continuous open support for AMD, Intel, and Apple Silicon. The home of open-source AI now joins the undisputed king of AI hardware.
